picks.what: The town seen from an RAF biplane, painting (Imperial War Museum)
picks.why: only general view before modern times: the town, its fields and the river valley from the air, in color

gaps: P0–P4: nothing usable (district and ethnographic maps, an Ottoman yearbook page); P6: kept the existing 2026 aerial view of the citadel
notes: The town is small in the painting, so the focal point sits on it below the left-hand biplane. Alternative for P5: Matson’s 1932 photo of the ramp up to the citadel (#9), a street scene with a light leak and a broken corner. Gröber’s mosque photo (#10) is dated only “before 1926”.
